action_matching_condition: only minimal on-shell hadronic four-current projection; any BHSM additional photons/interface/formation corrections and differing kernels require separate matching
alpha_scaling_at_fixed_correlator: exact cubic; requires binding source alpha0 normalization before numeric rescaling
current_normalization: minimal electromagnetic quark current; on-shell physical muon; alpha(0)^3 perturbative HLbL order
independent_inputs: hadronic transition form factors/cross sections/decay widths and theoretical short-distance constraints; measured muon anomaly not used
mass_scaling: T_i kernels depend on muon mass; no universal exact m_mu^2 rescaling or derivative bound from published scalar alone

nearby_metrology_approximation.alpha_dependence: exact cubic at fixed four-current function and mass; source alpha0 numeric not given in the two inspected primary papers
nearby_metrology_approximation.exact_alternative_producer: re-evaluate2412.00190 Eq4 kernels T_i(Sigma,r,phi;mselected) on source12Pi_bar functions/TFF/SDC inputs
nearby_metrology_approximation.justification: massive Euclidean lepton kernels are smooth near the physical muon mass; leading m^2/log behavior gives order-unity logarithmic sensitivity and100 is a deliberately generous modeling allowance
nearby_metrology_approximation.limitation: no actual HLbL tensor derivative norm integrated; this is a nearby-mass modeling estimate, NOT an exact derivative or rigorous bound; published center is not rescaled
nearby_metrology_approximation.reference_role: known configured MuLan2013 reference only, NOT attributed to HLbL paper

overlap.light_pseudoscalar_poles: subtracted from OPE/pQCD regions before adding exclusive poles; counted once

projection_equation: Eq4: alpha^3/(432*pi^2) int_0^infty dSigma Sigma^3 int_0^1 dr r*sqrt(1-r^2) int_0^2pi dphi sum_i=1^12 T_i(Sigma,r,phi;m_mu)*Pi_bar_i
source_uncertainty: experimental TFF fits plus matching scale variation, U3/tensor assumptions, effective-pole/short-distance modeling and charm uncertainty; not a rigorous enclosure
